text:
alex: Auditor requested an evidence bundle that proves the RBAC fix for CVE-2026-9981 was built from audited CI artifacts and deployed with KMS-backed secret rotation. Need chain: vuln -> ticket -> PR -> CI artifact (signed) -> deploy -> audit logs -> KMS activity. Sampling OK.
priya: We have ticket VULN-521, PR https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/5120 (branch: rbac/patch-521). CI artifact is stored in the artifact registry with sha256: f3a9... We sign artifacts with cosign. Auditor: is a cosign/Rekor proof acceptable?
auditor_claire: Yes, cosign + rekor timestamp is fine. Provide the rekor entry URL and a PDF that maps artifact -> control (one control per PDF). For SOC2 map to CC5/CC6 and ISO A.6/A.12.
omar: Collection notes: extract k8s audit slice for the deploy window and cloud audit logs for IAM changes. Example command I used:
```
kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-collector --since=96h | jq 'select(.objectRef.name=="platform-api" and .verb=="patch")' > /tmp/platform-patch-audit.json
```
That returned ~2.7k lines.
priya: KMS usage query (BigQuery):
```
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.methodName, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, resourceName
FROM `telemetry.kms_audit`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName IN ("Encrypt","Decrypt","UpdateCryptoKeyVersion")
  AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP("2026-06-01") AND TIMESTAMP("2026-06-05")
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 2000;
```
I plan to pseudonymize principalEmail using HMAC-SHA256 with a per-bundle salt stored in internal-keystore.
security_ops: Approved. Store bundle_salt at internal-keystore/evidence/1808889999 and do NOT include mapping in the exported bundle. Document algorithm, salt path, and access policy in the README.
auditor_claire: HMAC approach acceptable. Please include one signed attestation stating originals are retained and the process to request an unredacted sample under NDA. We'll likely request one sample.
alex: CI details: cosign verify output and rekor URL will be included. We'll also add the CI pipeline run link and the build log snippet showing artifact checksum. Screenshots OK if redacted.
omar: Redaction snippet for emails/IPs (example):
```
sed -E 's/"principalEmail":\s*"[^"]+"/"principalEmail":"HMAC_REDACTED"/g' platform-patch-audit.json > platform-patch-audit-redacted.json
```
Then run HMAC step to replace placeholders with real HMACs in the CSV export.
priya: Packaging plan: manifest.txt (index + algorithms + cosign/rekor proofs + sha256 bundle hash), control-crosswalk-CC5-CC6-A6-A12.pdf, signed-attestation.pdf, logs-redacted.tar.gz, kms-hmac.csv. Host at gs://redwood-evidence/packets/1808889999/evidence-bundle-1808889999.zip. Evidence-bot: start packaging.
evidence-bot: packaging job started: evidence-bundle-1808889999.zip (4 artifacts). ETA ~60s.
security_ops: Add KMS attestation note: keys are HSM-backed, rotation schedule recorded, include key version IDs used during deploy window.
auditor_claire: Good. After I validate the bundle, I may request a single unredacted log line under NDA to verify HMAC mapping. Please include escalation contact in README.
alex: Uploaded: gs://redwood-evidence/packets/1808889999/evidence-bundle-1808889999.zip (4.9MB). SHA256: d4c2... Manifest includes rekor URL: https://rekor.sigstore.dev/entries/0a1b2c...
priya: PR to compliance repo: https://github.com/redwood/compliance/pull/201 adds the mapping table linking each artifact file to SOC2/ISO controls.
auditor_claire: I'll review and ACK or request NDA sample. Thanks everyone.
alex: Closing loop once auditor confirms they can open the bundle.
